connector.name: Pdfrender
connector.registryDescription: HTML-to-PDF MCP server - render pixel-faithful PDFs from HTML.
connector.summary: Hosted at api.pdfrender.dev over streamable HTTP. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace dev.pdfrender, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

headers.name: X-API-Key
headers.description: Optional API key; the anonymous tier works without it
